import pytest from target import unescapeHTML @pytest.mark.parametrize( "input_str,expected", [ # Normal entities should be unescaped ("Fish & Chips", "Fish & Chips"), ("A < B > C", "A < B > C"), (""Hello"", '"Hello"'), # Multiple correct entities ("<div>Hello & welcome</div>", "
Hello & welcome
"), # Entities with an extra '&' inside should remain unchanged (old behavior) ("Bad &foo&bar; test", "Bad &foo&bar; test"), ("Mix & &bad&entity; end", "Mix & &bad&entity; end"), # Entity that ends with ';' but contains '&' before it should not be transformed ("Edge case &abc&def; here", "Edge case &abc&def; here"), ], ) def test_unescapeHTML_behaviour(input_str, expected): assert unescapeHTML(input_str) == expected def test_unescapeHTML_none(): assert unescapeHTML(None) is None def test_unescapeHTML_type_assertion(): with pytest.raises(AssertionError): unescapeHTML(123) # not a string
